content: As in the title. If all reviewers can be trusted then this seem a bit wasteful on tokens.
I don't understand what you mean by "recycle".
I mean the :recycle: feature. (https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCetiReview/pull/37?)
Huh, that's the recycle emoji, but the word “recycle” itself is indeed never used in the code. Explains my confusion I guess.
I'll take a look, this seems like a good suggestion.

@Erik (√2, sqrt-of-2) I think you may want to upgrade the reviewer to have this feature (should improve efficiency). I see at least one of your automated comment is not using this.

(possible suggestion: post the reviewer's version together with each scoreboard? This will _not_ automatically check for updates but at least we know which reviewer version is being used)

user202729 said:

(possible suggestion: post the reviewer's version together with each scoreboard? This will _not_ automatically check for updates but at least we know which reviewer version is being used)

TauCetiReview#157

:robot: Claude says: Done in TauCetiProject/TauCetiReview#157: scoreboards now end with CLI @ abc1234 in the footer (the commit of the tauceti-review CLI that posted it, with (modified) for a checkout with local edits). A scoreboard with no CLI @ entry at all comes from a CLI older than this change. If you installed with uv tool install, uv tool upgrade tauceti-review gets you current.
Apparently AI is slower than human in posting the announcement.
I didn't realize the reviewer can be installed from pypi (?) too. No harm, but given the (seeming) frequency of updates and the ease (with agent's assistance) of running from source
